recipe.title: Ruth's Cinnamon Rolls
recipe.headnote: Christmas morning, 1987 onwards. She started the dough the night before and the house smelled like cinnamon before anyone was allowed downstairs. The icing goes on while they're still warm — it should melt into the swirls, not sit on top.

steps.label: bloom the yeast
steps.text: Stir the 3/4 cup warm milk, 2 1/4 tsp yeast, and 1/4 cup sugar. Wait until it foams.

steps.label: mix the wet dough
steps.text: Beat in the egg and the 1/4 cup melted butter.

steps.label: knead
steps.text: Add the 3 cups flour and 1 tsp salt. Knead on medium until the dough is smooth and pulls from the bowl.

steps.label: first rise
steps.text: Cover and let rise until doubled.

steps.label: make the filling
steps.text: Mash the 1/2 cup softened butter with 3/4 cup brown sugar and 2 tbsp cinnamon into a paste.

steps.label: roll the dough
steps.text: Punch down and roll into a 12-by-16-inch rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.

steps.label: spread the filling
steps.text: Spread the cinnamon butter over the dough, leaving a 1/2-inch strip along one long edge.

steps.label: roll into a log
steps.text: Roll up from the long side into a tight log and pinch the seam.

steps.label: cut into 12
steps.text: Slice the log into 12 rolls and nestle them in a buttered 9x13 pan.

steps.label: second rise
steps.text: Cover and let the rolls puff until they touch.

steps.label: bake
steps.text: Bake until the tops are golden and the centers are set.

steps.label: beat the icing
steps.text: Beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth, then the powdered sugar and vanilla.

steps.label: frost
steps.text: Spread the icing over the rolls while they are still just warm.

equipment.name: stand mixer
equipment.size: bowl fitted with the dough hook

images.alt: A pan of iced cinnamon rolls
images.caption: Still warm. The icing should gloss, not sit.

notes.author: ruth
notes.text: Don't skip the second rise. If they look shy in the pan, give them another 15 minutes.

recipes.title: The Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.headnote: The back-of-the-bag recipe, except she always adds more chips than it says.

steps.label: cream butter and sugars
steps.text: Beat the butter with both sugars until light.

steps.label: beat in eggs
steps.text: Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.

steps.label: add the dry
steps.text: Stir in the flour, baking soda, and salt just until you don't see flour.

steps.label: fold in chips
steps.text: Fold in the 2 cups chocolate chips.

steps.label: bake
steps.text: Scoop onto a sheet pan and bake until the edges are set and the centers still look soft.

equipment.name: stand mixer
equipment.size: bowl fitted with the dough hook

images.alt: A pile of chocolate chip cookies

recipes.title: Emergency Cinnamon Toast
recipes.headnote: For the mornings the rolls did not happen. She never wrote this down; Tucker did.

owner.name: Ruth Brewer
owner.source: the way she always made it

steps.label: toast the bread
steps.text: Toast the bread. Butter it. Sugar and cinnamon on top. That's it.
